newsitem.title: USA: Foreign exchange Index posts gains in 1st half '97.
newsitem.headline: Foreign exchange Index posts gains in 1st half '97.

text.p: Foreign exchange fund managers reported gains for the first half of 1997, according to a report by Parker Global Strategies.
The Parker FX Index, which measures the risk adjusted returns of global currency managers, was up 5.06% on a reported basis with a median return up 4.31 percent.

Compucom Finance Inc of Switzerland posted the highest gain among companies reporting, up 28.63%, with Dean Witter's Currency Portfolio reporting second best at 22.09%. Union Cal Limited of London reported a gain of 6.76%, the highest gain on a risk adjusted basis.
The survey indicates volatility in European currencies may have driven the gains.

The Parker FX Index benchmark supplants the Ferrell FX Index, which was acquired by Parker Global Strategies on July 15. The Parker FX Index includes 59 programs managed by 43 firms located in the U.S., U.K., Ireland and Switzerland, managing over $6.4 billion in currency assets.
